top_by_total_time.query: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM vehicles WHERE tenant_id = $1) AS vehicles, (SELECT count(*) FROM vehicles WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND status = $2) AS vehicles_in_workshop, (SELECT count(*) FROM alerts WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND status = $3 AND severity = $4) AS open_critical_alerts, (SELECT count(*) FROM alerts WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND status = $5 AND severity = $6) AS open_warning_alerts, (SELECT count(*) FROM alerts WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND status = $7) AS acknowledged_alerts, (SELECT count(*) FROM work_orders WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND status = $8) AS work_orders_proposed, (SELECT count(*) FROM work_orders WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND status = $9) AS work_orders_scheduled, (SELECT count(*) FROM work_orders WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND status = $10) AS work_orders_in_progress

SELECT work_order_id::text AS work_order_id, vehicle_id::text AS vehicle_id, workshop_id::text AS workshop_id, source_alert_id, failure_mode, status, failure_probability::float8 AS failure_probability, expected_cost_avoided::float8 AS expected_cost_avoided, model_version, scheduled_for, created_by::text AS created_by, created_at, completed_at, outcome FROM work_orders WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND status = $2 AND (created_at, work_order_id) < ($3::timestamptz, $4::uuid) ORDER BY created_at DESC, work_order_id DESC LIMIT $5

INSERT INTO work_orders (tenant_id, vehicle_id, workshop_id, source_alert_id, failure_mode, status, failure_probability, expected_cost_avoided, model_version, scheduled_for) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $10, $6, $7, $8, $9) ON CONFLICT (vehicle_id, failure_mode) WHERE status IN ($11, $12, $13) DO NOTHING RETURNING work_order_id::text

SELECT a.alert_id, a.tenant_id::text, a.vehicle_id::text, a.failure_mode, a.rule_code, a.severity, extract($1 FROM now() - a.event_ts) / $2, (a.details ->> $3)::float8, hw.latitude::float8, hw.longitude::float8 FROM alerts a JOIN vehicles v ON v.vehicle_id = a.vehicle_id LEFT JOIN workshops hw ON hw.workshop_id = v.home_workshop_id WHERE a.status IN ($4, $5) AND a.failure_mode IS NOT NULL AND v.status = $6 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT $7 FROM work_orders w WHERE w.vehicle_id = a.vehicle_id AND w.failure_mode = a.failure_mode AND w.status IN ($8, $9, $10))

SELECT v.vehicle_id::text AS vehicle_id, v.vin::text AS vin, v.model_code::text AS model_code, m.display_name AS model_name, m.oem_code AS oem, m.powertrain, v.model_year, v.firmware_version, v.status, v.fleet_id::text AS fleet_id, v.home_workshop_id::text AS home_workshop_id FROM vehicles v JOIN vehicle_models m USING (model_code) WHERE v.tenant_id = $1 AND v.vehicle_id > $2 ORDER BY v.vehicle_id LIMIT $3

SELECT v.vehicle_id::text AS vehicle_id, v.vin::text AS vin, v.model_code::text AS model_code, m.display_name AS model_name, m.oem_code AS oem, m.powertrain, v.model_year, v.firmware_version, v.status, v.fleet_id::text AS fleet_id, v.home_workshop_id::text AS home_workshop_id FROM vehicles v JOIN vehicle_models m USING (model_code) WHERE v.tenant_id = $1 ORDER BY v.vehicle_id LIMIT $2

SELECT work_order_id::text AS work_order_id, vehicle_id::text AS vehicle_id, workshop_id::text AS workshop_id, source_alert_id, failure_mode, status, failure_probability::float8 AS failure_probability, expected_cost_avoided::float8 AS expected_cost_avoided, model_version, scheduled_for, created_by::text AS created_by, created_at, completed_at, outcome FROM work_orders WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND (created_at, work_order_id) < ($2::timestamptz, $3::uuid) ORDER BY created_at DESC, work_order_id DESC LIMIT $4

SELECT v.vehicle_id::text AS vehicle_id, v.vin::text AS vin, v.model_code::text AS model_code, m.display_name AS model_name, m.oem_code AS oem, m.powertrain, v.model_year, v.firmware_version, v.status, v.fleet_id::text AS fleet_id, v.home_workshop_id::text AS home_workshop_id , (SELECT count(*) FROM alerts a WHERE a.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id AND a.status IN ($3, $4)) AS open_alerts FROM vehicles v JOIN vehicle_models m USING (model_code) WHERE v.vehicle_id = $1 AND v.tenant_id = $2

SELECT alert_id, vehicle_id::text AS vehicle_id, rule_code, severity, failure_mode, status, event_ts, detected_at, acknowledged_at, acknowledged_by::text AS acknowledged_by, resolved_at, details FROM alerts WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND (detected_at, alert_id) < ($2::timestamptz, $3) ORDER BY detected_at DESC, alert_id DESC LIMIT $4

SELECT alert_id, vehicle_id::text AS vehicle_id, rule_code, severity, failure_mode, status, event_ts, detected_at, acknowledged_at, acknowledged_by::text AS acknowledged_by, resolved_at, details FROM alerts WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND status = $2 AND (detected_at, alert_id) < ($3::timestamptz, $4) ORDER BY detected_at DESC, alert_id DESC LIMIT $5

SELECT alert_id, vehicle_id::text AS vehicle_id, rule_code, severity, failure_mode, status, event_ts, detected_at, acknowledged_at, acknowledged_by::text AS acknowledged_by, resolved_at, details FROM alerts WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND status = $2 AND severity = $3 AND (detected_at, alert_id) < ($4::timestamptz, $5) ORDER BY detected_at DESC, alert_id DESC LIMIT $6

SELECT work_order_id::text AS work_order_id, vehicle_id::text AS vehicle_id, workshop_id::text AS workshop_id, source_alert_id, failure_mode, status, failure_probability::float8 AS failure_probability, expected_cost_avoided::float8 AS expected_cost_avoided, model_version, scheduled_for, created_by::text AS created_by, created_at, completed_at, outcome FROM work_orders WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND status = $2 ORDER BY created_at DESC, work_order_id DESC LIMIT $3
